children.title: Mechanisms of Objectivity: Quantum Darwinism and Redundancy

detail.title: Mechanisms of Objectivity: Quantum Darwinism and Redundancy
detail.summary: Robustness in quantum records arises from the redundancy of information stored in the environment. Quantum Darwinism framework posits that multiple observers can retrieve the same information by measuring distinct fragments of the environment, provided those fragments decohere into preferred pointer states.
detail.reason: Revision required to solidify the link between redundancy and observer consensus using established peer literature.
